created.description: Game created with settings (name, PIN, fee, leagues, rollover/split pot). Not yet shared.

waiting_for_players.description: Game shared via link/PIN. Players join by paying the admission fee.

active.description: Game in progress. Creator adds rounds by choosing matchdays from selected leagues.

pending.description: Round created — matchday chosen by creator, picks not yet open.

picking.description: Players selecting one team from the matchday fixtures. No repeat picks allowed.

locked.description: Pick deadline passed. Matches are being played.

processing.description: Match results available. Calculating eliminations based on pick outcomes.

complete.description: Eliminations applied. Waiting for creator to add next round or game to end.

completed.description: Game finished. Winner takes pot, or pot split among last remaining players.

rollover_pending.description: No singular winner — all remaining players eliminated in the same round. Collecting repayment of original fee from ALL original participants. Prize fund doubles.

cancelled.description: Game cancelled by creator. Fees refunded to players.

alive.description: Player is active in the game and can make picks.

eliminated.description: Player's team lost or drew. They are out of the game.

deferred.description: Player's chosen match was postponed. They advance to the next round but must succeed on both their original and new pick when the postponed match is rescheduled.

win.description: Team won the match. Player survives to the next round.

loss.description: Team lost the match. Player is eliminated.

draw.description: Team drew the match. Player is eliminated.

postponed.description: Match was postponed. Player advances but carries a deferred obligation to the rescheduled matchday.

transitions.description: Creator shares the game link/PIN. Game opens for players to join.
Creator cancels the game before sharing.
Creator adds the first round by choosing a matchday. Game becomes active.
Creator cancels the game while players are joining.
Creator opens picks for the round. Players can now select their team.
Pick deadline has passed. No more picks accepted.
Match results are in. System processes outcomes for each player's pick.
Eliminations calculated and applied. Round is complete.
Creator adds the next round. Surviving players continue.
Only one player remains. They win the entire pot.
All remaining players eliminated in the same round. Pot is split equally among them.
All remaining players eliminated. Rollover is enabled — collecting repayment from all original participants.
All original participants have repaid the fee. Prize fund doubles. Game restarts with all original players.
Creator cancels during rollover fee collection.

hasMultipleSurvivors.description: More than one player has 'alive' status after the round.

exactlyOneSurvivor.description: Exactly one player has 'alive' status — they are the winner.

allEliminatedAndSplitPot.description: All remaining players were eliminated in the same round AND the game has 'splitPot' enabled.

allEliminatedAndRollover.description: All remaining players were eliminated in the same round AND the game has 'rollover' enabled (takes precedence over splitPot if both set).

noRepeatPick.description: Player has not previously picked this team in any earlier round of the game.

playerHasDeferredPick.description: Player has a deferred obligation from a postponed match. They must succeed on both picks in the round containing the rescheduled fixture.
